generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Beta Find Mount Behavior
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Allows the mob to look around for another mob to ride atop it.

fields.title: Avoid Water
fields.description: If true, the mob will not go into water blocks when going towards a mount

fields.title: Max Failed Attempts
fields.description: Number of attempts to find mount

fields.title: Mount Distance
fields.description: This is the distance the mob needs to be, in blocks, from the desired mount to mount it. If the value is below 0, the mob will use its default attack distance

fields.title: Start Delay
fields.description: Time the mob will wait before starting to move towards the mount

fields.title: Target Needed
fields.description: If true, the mob will only look for a mount if it has a target

fields.title: Within Radius
fields.description: Distance in blocks within which the mob will look for a mount
